Part.name: Duplet hull (legacy — 1 zone)
Part.description: Legacy one-zone version retained for saved vehicles. For three independent zones, place the new Duplet hull - 3 zones part. Long Oplot-style hull ERA module with tapered ends and bolted mounting tabs. Estimated size 900 x 300 x 70 mm; about 74.7 kg. Follows vehicle paint and camouflage. One module reacts once against eligible HEAT or APFSDS hits, with up to 55% less remaining HEAT penetration and 20% less APFSDS penetration. Place the flat mounting side against the vehicle and the closed face outward. Freely move, rotate, mirror and duplicate. Return to Edit to restore. Gameplay calibration; no tandem simulation. Spent mounts, passive collision and mass remain.
